title: LAST SIGNAL — ONE LAST MESSAGE
logline: A forgotten flip phone receives one final message and relights a silent observatory.

design.object: graphite ceramic, warm ivory keys, oxidized copper mechanics, teal display
design.set: communication observatory with three sequential signal portals
design.lighting: warm directional key, teal rim, soft top, low ambient world
design.typography: minimal off-white grotesk overlays; no text over mechanical action

acts.name: proof
acts.function: restrained lift and true final still

motion_rules: no parent and descendant animated for the same reveal
camera remains static during linear transport
only one dominant movement per beat
